result.summary: This residential street features narrow sidewalks directly adjacent to the curb with no buffer from traffic. The presence of parked cars on both sides and utility poles within the walkway creates physical and visual obstructions for pedestrians.

hazards.description: Parked cars along both sides of the narrow street limit visibility for pedestrians and drivers at potential crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at the upcoming intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental-style crosswalk markings at the intersection to clearly delineate pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to create a buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, enhancing the pedestrian environment and encouraging slower driving speeds.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow concrete sidewalk adjacent to a brick residential building. The environment exhibits signs of neglect, including significant weed growth in sidewalk cracks and low-hanging utility wires along the building facade.

hazards.name: Low-hanging Wires

interventions.description: Remove weeds and patch cracks in the concrete to provide a smooth, level walking surface.

interventions.description: Secure loose utility wires properly to the building or relocate them underground to eliminate snag hazards.
